component.name: animaEngine
component.summary: Animated character overlay for your Linux desktop
Suprapunere cu personaje animate pentru desktop-ul tău Linux

description.p: animaEngine renders multiple animated characters or sprites on top of your desktop using transparent, always-on-top windows with GPU acceleration. It's written in Rust with wgpu and winit — no Electron, no Chromium, minimal RAM footprint.

ul.li: Click-through by default — your desktop stays fully usable
Drag-and-drop PNG, GIF, WebP, JPEG, or H.264 MP4 files to add characters
Per-entity behaviors: walk-around, follow-cursor, bounded-wander
System tray icon and global hotkeys (Ctrl+Shift+A/H/P)
Hot-reload of the TOML config — edit live
Native X11 (XShape click-through) and experimental wlr-layer-shell paths

description.p: UI/UX polish, release-build provenance, and X11 window-awareness.

ul.li: Reduce-motion toggle, a first-run tour, inspector slider units with double-click reset, and a keyboard-navigable command palette.
High-contrast theme variants now restyle every custom widget; the whole UI is translated across all ten locales.
Physics-enabled characters can land on and walk along the top edges of your windows (X11 only).
Tag-triggered release builds with provenance attestations and embedded SBOMs; on-disk crash reports.

description.p: Content and feature completion: multi-state animations and Shimeji pack import.

ul.li: Entities switch between idle, walk, fall and drag animation sequences automatically, with direction-aware sprite mirroring.
Import Shimeji desktop-mascot packs by dropping the pack folder onto the overlay — sprites, states and walk speed map automatically.
The asset library shows thumbnails, generated in the background.
Sprite groups now apply their offset and scale visually, in the hit-test and in the inspector.

description.p: Platform completeness: portal-based global shortcuts and true multi-monitor rendering.

ul.li: Global hotkeys via the GlobalShortcuts desktop portal (GNOME 48+, KDE Plasma 5.27+) — native Wayland sessions get working shortcuts without XWayland; automatic fallback to XGrabKey elsewhere.
Per-monitor overlay windows: entities render on the monitor their position or pin resolves to; hotplug rebuilds windows and re-resolves pins with a notification.
The Keybindings tab shows which shortcut backend is active.
Suspend/resume and stall-recovery test protocol documented.

description.p: Performance, correctness and hardening release driven by two external reviews plus the audit that verified them.

ul.li: Idle-aware frame pacing: the overlay no longer redraws at display refresh around the clock — a static scene sleeps (2 s heartbeat), playing sprites wake the loop at their own frame rate, edit mode stays at full refresh.
The launcher icon finally renders: the SVG started with an XML prolog that gdk-pixbuf's format sniffing never recognised, so GNOME Shell drew a blank tile since 0.2.0.
Animations with per-frame GIF/WebP delays keep correct timing when frames are skipped; the BounceOut easing no longer shortens the loop.
A full 64-entity scene draws every sprite (quad budget off-by-two) and preset Replace no longer leaks GPU textures.
Aggregate decoded-memory budget (1 GB default, ANIMA_MEMORY_BUDGET_MB to override) on top of the per-asset cap.
Asset cache key includes nanosecond mtime + size, so same-second edits invalidate correctly.
XDG fallback directories prefer XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and verify tmpdir ownership before use.

description.p: Post-refactor audit follow-up: two high and two medium findings closed, none exploitable from a cold start.

ul.li: The 64-entity cap is enforced on every runtime add path (drag-drop, library, duplicate, presets), not just config load.
Config-path fallback hardened to a uid-scoped directory.
Redaction sweep over three remaining info-level log lines; library log lines resist hand-edited control characters.
Translation lookups recover from a poisoned lock instead of taking the render thread down.

description.p: Re-audit follow-up to 0.5.2. Zero regressions found from the previous patches; two medium and four low audit findings addressed.

ul.li: Finish the path-redaction sweep across 11 remaining info-level traces.
Filter Unicode Cf characters (zero-width / bidi-override / format codes) from text events on the Wayland path.
PNG sequence loader applies the decoded-bytes cap during parallel decode to avoid transient peak memory.
Search-box TextEdit widgets gain char_limit(256).
D-Bus try_send overflow logs at debug level with method name and error.
Asset library scanner canonicalises entries and drops anything escaping the library root.
SAFETY comments added to libc::getuid call sites introduced in 0.5.2.

description.p: Follow-up to 0.5.1. Closes the four medium-severity audit findings (path-traversal hardening on the library, safer XDG fallback when ProjectDirs unreachable, redacted paths in info logs, pid-scoped atomic-write temp files) plus a documentation language sweep.

ul.li: Library asset paths now canonicalised and rejected when they escape library_root.
XDG fallback uses uid-scoped tmpdir instead of honouring $HOME blindly.
Info-level traces log file names only; full paths moved to debug.
util::tmp_sibling includes pid so racing instances can't truncate each other's tmp files.
Documentation sweep: anglicised phase labels, removed lingering model-name references.

description.p: Security patch for the opt-in native Wayland backend. Eight findings from a 0.5.0 audit addressed — three critical, four high, one informational. The default X11 backend is unaffected; users running ANIMA_USE_WAYLAND_NATIVE=1 should upgrade promptly.

ul.li: Wayland drop now runs the X11 path's pre-validate gate (size cap + extension whitelist + regular-file check).
Drop reader thread bounded: 64 KiB read cap, max 4 concurrent workers, bounded result channel.
D-Bus action queue switched to sync_channel(64) with per-frame coalescing of idempotent toggles.
URI-list parser capped at 256 paths to foreclose unbounded Vec allocation.
percent_decode reconstructs UTF-8 properly; files with diacritics in their names now drop correctly.
Control characters from xkbcommon utf8 stripped before egui Text dispatch.
threat-model.md documents the expanded D-Bus surface and the coalescing mitigations.

description.p: Phase E — platform reach (Linux half). The native Wayland backend reaches feature parity with the X11 path on wlroots compositors. macOS and FreeBSD remain out of scope for 0.5 — without hardware to test on, scaffolding those would be promising support we can't honour.

ul.li: Native Wayland keyboard via sctk's xkbcommon feature — keysym decoding, UTF-8 composition, modifier tracking.
Pointer + drag-drop (text/uri-list) wired end-to-end on the wlr-layer-shell path.
Egui paint integration: settings panel, command palette, toasts, context menu all render on the native Wayland surface.
D-Bus global-shortcut bridge — compositor bindings (sway/Hyprland/river) invoke ToggleEditMode / HideOverlay / ToggleGlobalPlayback via gdbus.
wl_output enumeration drives the multi-monitor picker; HiDPI scales egui's pixels_per_point.
cargo-fuzz harness covers the chord parser, URI-list parser, and asset-type detector.
docs/wayland.md and docs/fuzzing.md cover usage and CI integration.

description.p: Phase D — UX completion. Ten sub-phases across rebindable keyboard map, persistent panel state, runtime AccessKit toggle, locale review pipeline, surfaced failure paths, live perf overlay, onboarding polish, empty-state CTAs, and a consistency sweep.

ul.li: Rebindable keyboard map: 27 actions in a dedicated Keybindings tab with record / conflict-detect / reset; chord set persists in config.toml and the global hotkeys read from it.
Persistent collapse state for inspector sections + preset gallery so users don't re-collapse the same surfaces after every restart.
Runtime AccessKit toggle in Appearance → Accessibility; AT-SPI tree-update generation can be turned off without rebuilding.
Native-speaker review pipeline + per-locale audit docs + GitHub issue template under docs/locale-audit/.
Persistent warning banners + filled-in toast wiring at previously silent failure paths.
Live perf overlay (Ctrl+Shift+`): FPS + per-system timings + RSS + 120-frame sparkline + chrome-tracing JSON snapshot export.
Onboarding 2.0: "What's new in 0.4" highlight panel + new hint sites + "Reset onboarding hints" button.
Empty-state CTAs route users to the next action (Browse presets, Copy asset path).

description.p: Patch release fixing the launcher icon for real this time. Two related freedesktop-spec corner cases caused GNOME Shell 47+ on Ubuntu to render the launcher entry without an icon even though the PNGs were valid and the hicolor theme cache was fresh.

ul.li: Rename the .desktop file to com.animaengine.Anima.desktop so it matches the AppStream <id> — GNOME Shell uses that filename↔id relationship as a key for icon resolution in the dock/launcher.

Set X11 WM_CLASS + Wayland app_id explicitly to "animaEngine" so the runtime window matches the .desktop StartupWMClass; without this, the dock would create a separate "running" entry alongside the pinned one.

description.p: Patch release fixing a missing app-launcher icon on GNOME/Yaru and any other desktop that resolves icons through hicolor's discrete-size lookup before falling back to scalable/.

ul.li: Ship pre-rasterized PNGs at 16/24/32/48/64/128/256 px alongside the scalable SVG.
Makefile install + cargo-deb assets pick them up automatically; build-deb.sh runs the new render-icons.sh first.
gtk-update-icon-cache refresh wired into make install / uninstall.

description.p: Phase C — engine polish. Ten sub-phases across multi-monitor, multi-window data, asset library, behavior expansion, animation curves, and sprite groups.

ul.li: Multi-monitor distribution modes (PerMonitor / Span / Single-by-name) with per-entity pin and Ctrl+M cycle hotkey.
Multi-window data layer — WindowConfig with backwards-compat migration.
Asset library — directory scan, persistent index, search-filter UI, drag-drop validation preserved on every "Add to scene".
Bounce behavior (Horizontal / Vertical / Both axes) with rest-position locking and drag invalidation.
Six easing curves on the per-frame timing pipeline; GIF/WebP delays remain authoritative.
Sprite groups (data + visibility composition); a hidden group hides every member, click hit-test honours it.
Hand-tuned performance baseline ships under examples/perf_baseline.rs.

description.p: Patch release fixing a startup crash on systems without libxkbcommon-x11 preinstalled. Affects AppImage on minimal containers and fresh .deb installs.

ul.li: Bundle libxkbcommon-x11 explicitly in the AppImage (linuxdeploy can't discover dlopen'd libraries on its own).
Add libxkbcommon-x11-0 to .deb depends.
Install libxkbcommon-x11-dev across all CI jobs so smoke tests pass on Xvfb runners.

description.p: UI/UX polish release. Twelve sub-phases focused on coherence, accessibility, and localisation.

ul.li: Four themes: Dark, Light, Dark · High contrast, Light · High contrast (WCAG AAA).
Tabbed settings sidebar: Inspector, Scene, Appearance.
Six bundled scene presets — Append or Replace.
Ctrl+K command palette with fuzzy search over themes and presets.
Ten UI languages — English, Română, Español, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Português (BR), Polski, Nederlands, 日本語.
AccessKit bridge for AT-SPI screen readers; keyboard reference table in Appearance.
New Ghost Mascot app icon.
